name: A References panel or section is present after the analysis text
description: The analysis tab should include a References or Sources section below the analysis paragraphs, listing the sources that were cited inline in the text.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket cell to open a match detail page
Scroll down past the analysis paragraphs to look for a references or sources section
Verify that a References, Sources, or Citations section is visible below the analysis paragraphs. It should contain at least one numbered reference entry with a URL or source name.
